templates.name: 1. 淡入淡出
templates.description: 动效转场：淡入淡出 / Fade to Black — the outgoing scene gradually darkens to pure black, then the incoming scene fades up from black
templates.description_en: Fade to Black - the outgoing scene gradually darkens to pure black, then the incoming scene fades up from black
templates.prompt:
A seamless Fade to Black transition effect between two scenes.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-3s] The first scene holds steady in a cinematic composition. The frame is stable, the lighting is balanced, and the subject is clearly visible, establishing the visual context that will be transformed by the transition.
[Shot 2] [3-6s] The outgoing scene gradually darkens to pure black, then the incoming scene fades up from black. The transition executes with fluid, natural motion and cinematic quality. The camera movement and visual effect remain smooth and continuous, completing the handoff from the first scene to the second scene seamlessly.

overall_soundscape: soft rising ambient tone as darkness swallows the frame, gentle breath-like fade. No dialogue, no music in the soundscape layer.

non_diegetic_music: a minimal ambient pad that swells and recedes, synced to the rhythm of the transition for a polished editorial feel.
